oneLine: Prime Industries promoters cut their stake by 19.95% via open market sale.

sources.title: Prime Industries Promoters Cut Stake by 19.95% via Open Market Sale

synopsis: Prime Industries Ltd promoters and Persons Acting in Concert, including Rajinder Kumar Singhania, Puneet Singhania, Saintco India LLP, and Master Trust Limited, offloaded 41,91,600 shares representing a 19.95% stake through open market transactions on September 11, 2026. This divestment reduced the promoter group's total voting capital from 26.07% down to 6.11%. The article does not disclose the financial deal value or the buyers involved in the open market sale.
